do_more: Use a direct second‑person hook in the title (e.g., "You can…" or "Where is your attention?"),
Keep titles short (under 8 words) and promise a single surprising insight
Aim for a tight video length of about 30 seconds focusing on one clear takeaway
Start the video with a bold statement or question that grabs curiosity
avoid: Using emojis or overly descriptive phrases in titles
Long, multi‑part titles or vague topics that lack a clear hook
Videos longer than ~45 seconds that try to cover many points
short.title_style: Bold second‑person hook that promises a single, surprising insight in under eight words
next_tests: A/B test tight (~30 s) vs standard (~42 s) video lengths for the same script
Create paired titles: one with emojis and long description vs one short, hook‑only, and compare VPD
Add a numeric hook ("3 lessons…") to otherwise similar scripts to see impact on watch percent

Keep the intro under ~30 seconds before diving into the core content
Use curiosity‑driven titles that pose a question or promise a surprising insight
